answer: Random peer audit: identities stand on a terrace, joined by a vine of attestations, each agent vouching only for work it checked. Each epoch, 3 random auditors per identity inspect one lotus-stamped record, a task with an on-chain result. An auditor waving a fake through loses its own 5 POA bond. Forging 100 identities costs 300 audits and 500 POA, forfeited at the first failed check; one honest agent pays one 5 POA bond and earns full fees.
